subject: ENGLISH
title: இன்றைய குறிப்புகள்: Poem: The Swimmer || கவிதை: நீச்சல் வீரர் & Supplementary: Practice Makes Perfect || துணைப்பாடம்: பயிற்சி முழுமை தரும்

quiz.q: What two things did Akilan consider as his 'two eyes'?
quiz.ex: Akilan was an active boy who liked sports as much as his studies, treating them like his two eyes.

quiz.q: When did Akilan usually spend his time on studies?
quiz.ex: Remembering his father's words, Akilan used to spend his mornings on studies and his evenings in the playground.

quiz.q: What was the memorable advice given by Akilan's father?
quiz.ex: His father always advised him saying, 'Learn well, live well!'

quiz.q: Who served as Akilan's inspiration to learn Judo?
options: His master at the Judo school
quiz.ex: His physical education teacher, who was good at Judo, was his inspiration.

quiz.q: Why was Akilan initially afraid to tell his parents about his interest in Judo?
options: He thought Judo was too expensive
He feared his parents would be upset
He had failed in his exams
He was afraid of getting injured
quiz.ex: He was afraid that his growing passion and interest in Judo would upset his parents.

quiz.q: How did Akilan's parents react when he finally showed them his sports medals and certificates?
quiz.ex: His parents were astonished (very surprised) on seeing the medals and certificates that he had won in school.

quiz.q: What tragedy struck Akilan a few months later?
options: He lost his left hand in an accident
His parents moved to another town
quiz.ex: After a few months, in an unfortunate accident, Akilan lost his left hand.

quiz.q: How did the accident affect Akilan initially?
options: He used to sit in a corner and did not go out often
He became very angry at his friends
quiz.ex: After losing his hand, from that day onwards he did not go out of the house often and used to sit in a corner.

quiz.q: Where did Akilan's father come across the advertisement for a Judo school?
quiz.ex: His father showed an advertisement of a Judo school that he came across in a newspaper.

quiz.q: How did the father react when Akilan asked if he could join the Judo school?
options: He got him admitted with tears of joy
He told him to wait for a year
He asked him to choose studies instead
quiz.ex: His father, with tears of joy, got him admitted to the Judo school because they were keen to fulfill their son's passion.

quiz.q: What did the Judo master teach Akilan first?
quiz.ex: The master trained him the basics before teaching the advanced skills.

quiz.q: For how long did Akilan practice consistently in the Judo school?
quiz.ex: Akilan learnt and practiced consistently for two years.

quiz.q: Why was Akilan surprised and annoyed during his training?
options: The master charged too much fee
The master taught him only a single stroke for two years
He was not allowed to participate in matches
quiz.ex: Akilan was annoyed because his master taught him and made him practice only a single stroke for two years.

quiz.q: What major event was Akilan picked for by his master?
quiz.ex: To everyone's surprise, Akilan was picked by the master for the 'National Judo Competition'.

quiz.q: Why did everyone ridicule Akilan and his master?
options: Because they were not sure how a boy with one hand could win a national competition
Because the master was not famous
Because they didn't have proper uniforms
quiz.ex: People ridiculed (teased) them as they doubted how a boy with only one arm could possibly win in a national level competition.

quiz.q: How many contenders did Akilan easily defeat to reach the finals?
quiz.ex: To everyone's surprise, Akilan easily defeated all his six contenders with his single stroke.

quiz.q: How many total rounds were there in the final match?
quiz.ex: The final match began, and it had a total of six rounds.

quiz.q: What happened in the first two rounds of the final match?
quiz.ex: The opponent was very strong and defeated Akilan easily in the first two rounds.

quiz.q: What valuable advice did the master give Akilan when the referee blew the whistle?
options: "Believe yourself. The key to success is to focus on your strengths and not your weakness."
quiz.ex: The master rushed to him and told him to focus on his strengths rather than his weakness.

quiz.q: How did the final match conclude for Akilan?
options: He lost by a narrow margin
He scored four strokes and four knockouts, winning the finals
quiz.ex: Feeling new energy, Akilan scored four strokes and four knockouts, becoming the champion.

quiz.q: What was the secret behind Akilan's victory with that single stroke?
options: To beat him, the opponent had to hold his left hand, which he did not have
quiz.ex: The master explained that he taught him the most difficult stroke, and the only defense against it required holding his left hand.

quiz.q: Pictionary: What is a 'Gourd'?
options: A large vegetable with hard skin
quiz.ex: According to the pictionary, a gourd is a large vegetable with hard skin.

quiz.q: Pictionary: What is 'Judo'?
options: A sport where one tries to unbalance the opponents using arms and legs
A game played with a ball and a bat
quiz.ex: Judo is a martial art sport where one unbalances opponents using arms and legs.

quiz.q: Pictionary: What does 'Victory' mean?
quiz.ex: Victory means winning against an opponent.

quiz.q: Glossary: What is the meaning of the word 'passion'?
quiz.ex: Passion means having a strong emotion or deep interest in something.

quiz.q: Book Back Choose: His father wanted him to do well in ______.
quiz.ex: According to the book back exercise, his father always emphasized studies ('Learn well, live well!').

quiz.q: Book Back Identify the Speaker: "Believe yourself."
quiz.ex: The Master said these words to encourage Akilan during the final match.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: Find the synonym for 'happy'.
quiz.ex: Happy, joy, and glad denote the same feeling.

quiz.q: Grammar Synonyms: What word has the same meaning as 'cut'?
quiz.ex: Cut and chop are synonyms.

quiz.q: Grammar Antonyms: What is the opposite of 'full'?
quiz.ex: Full is the opposite of empty.

quiz.q:
Assertion (A): Everyone ridiculed Akilan and his master when he was selected for the National Competition.
Reason (R): They were not sure how a boy with one hand could win against normal competitors.
options: A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
Both A and R are false
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
quiz.ex: People mocked them because they couldn't believe a one-armed boy could win a national championship.

quiz.q: According to 'The Swimmer' poem, how does the swimmer stand at the beginning?
quiz.ex: The poem begins with the line: 'She stands still and tall'.

quiz.q: In the poem 'The Swimmer', what does she dive like?
quiz.ex: The poem states: 'She dives like the fish'.

quiz.q: What are the swimmer's strokes compared to in the poem?
quiz.ex: The poem describes her movements as: 'Her strokes like dancing light'.

quiz.q: How does the swimmer rip across the water?
quiz.ex: The lines say: 'And rips across the water with flair'.

quiz.q: Why do the audience cheer for the swimmer?
options: Because the finish line is near
quiz.ex: The audience cheer because they know that 'the finish line is near'.

quiz.q: According to the poem, why does the swimmer pick up her pace?
options: She wants to win the race
She is afraid of the water
quiz.ex: The poem states: 'She picks up her pace, As she wants to win the race'.

quiz.q: Does the swimmer give up the fight?
options: No, she never gives up the fight
The poem does not mention it
quiz.ex: The poet clearly mentions: 'She never gives up the fight'.

quiz.q: What happens as the swimmer reaches the wall?
options: Her name as winner they call
quiz.ex: The final lines say: 'As she reaches the wall, Her name as winner they call'.

quiz.q: Glossary: What is the meaning of 'flair'?
quiz.ex: Flair refers to a natural ability, talent, or stylishness.

quiz.q: Glossary: What does 'rips' mean in the context of the poem?
quiz.ex: In swimming, ripping across water means to pull oneself through it quickly or forcibly.

quiz.q: Glossary: What is the meaning of 'strain'?
quiz.ex: To strain means to use a lot of force or effort.

quiz.q: Rhyming words: Which pair correctly rhymes from the poem?
quiz.ex: 'Might' and 'fight' are rhyming pairs from the poem.

quiz.q: Rhyming words: What rhymes with 'tall' in the poem?
quiz.ex: In the poem, tall rhymes with all, wall, and call.

quiz.q: Grammar: Which conjunction is used to explain the reason for the first event?
quiz.ex: The word 'because' gives the reason for an action (e.g., I cannot go out because it is raining).

quiz.q: Grammar: Which conjunction is used to explain the result of the first event?
quiz.ex: The word 'so' explains the result or consequence (e.g., Priya was sick so she consulted a doctor).

quiz.q: Grammar Recall: He has a ball _________ not a bat. (Choose the correct conjunction)
quiz.ex: 'But' is used to show contrast.

quiz.q: Grammar Recall: Do you want apple _________ pear?
quiz.ex: 'Or' is used to present a choice or alternative.

quiz.q: Grammar Match: The cat was hungry -> _______
options: because she had to attend function.
quiz.ex: The result of the cat being hungry is that it ate a fish. Hence, 'so it ate a fish'.

quiz.q: Grammar Match: He was afraid of the dog -> _______
options: because she had to attend function.
quiz.ex: The result of being afraid of the dog is running away. Hence, 'so he ran away'.

quiz.q: Grammar Fill in the blank: He ate two chocolates _______ he got cough.
quiz.ex: Getting a cough is the result of eating chocolates, so 'so' is used.

quiz.q: Grammar Fill in the blank: The rat ran fast _______ a cat was chasing it.
quiz.ex: The reason the rat ran fast is that the cat was chasing it, so 'because' is used.

quiz.q: Grammar Fill in the blank: Tom left the class _______ he was sick.
quiz.ex: Being sick is the reason for leaving the class, so 'because' is correct.

quiz.q: Grammar Fill in the blank: He lost the key _______ he couldn’t open his room.
quiz.ex: Not being able to open the room is the result of losing the key, so 'so' is used.

quiz.q: Let Us Listen: What does the red signal in a traffic light mean?
quiz.ex: The red traffic signal always means 'to stop'.

quiz.q: Let Us Listen: What does the green signal mean?
quiz.ex: The green traffic signal means 'to go'.

quiz.q: Let Us Listen: When should pedestrians cross using the zebra crossing?
quiz.ex: It is safe to cross the zebra crossing only when the vehicles have completely stopped.

quiz.q: Let Us Listen: Why do we wear a helmet while riding a two-wheeler?
quiz.ex: Helmets protect the skull and brain, avoiding serious head injuries during accidents.

quiz.q: Let Us Listen: Can we use a cellphone while driving?
quiz.ex: Using a cellphone distracts the driver and causes accidents, so the answer is 'No'.

quiz.q: Life-situation (HOTS): Rosy was lost at the car festival. When a stranger offered to buy her food and take her to her parents, what did she do?
options: She refused to go with him and asked him to call her father's phone number
She took the food but stayed there
quiz.ex: Rosy followed the safety advice of her parents and teachers; she refused to go with the stranger but smartly provided her father's number.

quiz.q:
Assertion (A): Rosy gave her father's phone number to the stranger but refused to go with him.
Reason (R): She wanted to be safe because her parents and teachers advised her not to go with strangers.
options: A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
Both A and R are false
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
quiz.ex: Both the assertion and the reason are correct. Rosy acted smartly by seeking help without compromising her safety.

quiz.q: HOTS: Why is it important to memorize your parents' phone number?
options: To call them for chatting during class
It helps in emergencies if you get lost or separated in a crowd
To give it to random strangers for fun
quiz.ex: As seen in Rosy's situation, memorizing parents' contact numbers is crucial to safely contact them in case of an emergency.

quiz.q: What is the main profession of the old man in the story?
quiz.ex: The old man clearly states, 'I am a simple oil seller. I fill these gourds with oil and sell them.'

quiz.q: What container did the old man use to store and sell his oil?
quiz.ex: The old man says, 'I am sure you must have guessed that by seeing my gourds.'

quiz.q: How did Uthaman speak to the old man initially?
quiz.ex: Uthaman, in a mocking tone, said, 'Hmm… Show us your skills.'

quiz.q: What was the crowd's reaction when the oil seller offered to show his skill?
quiz.ex: Everyone was curious. They wanted to see what would happen next.

quiz.q: How did the oil seller feel when the crowd gathered around him?
quiz.ex: Unfazed by the crowd and by habit, the oil seller was calm.

quiz.q: What did the old man place on the mouth of the empty gourd?
quiz.ex: He then placed a small coin on the mouth of the gourd.

quiz.q: What was the coin made of?
quiz.ex: The small coin made of copper had a small hole at its centre.

quiz.q: What special feature did the copper coin have?
options: A small hole at its centre
quiz.ex: The small coin made of copper had a small hole at its centre.

quiz.q: What tool did the oil seller use to take the oil and pour it?
quiz.ex: The oil seller stood up, took some oil in his ladle and began to pour oil.

quiz.q: How did the oil enter the gourd?
options: He poured it slowly through a pipe
He removed the coin and poured it
It went straight into the gourd through the hole in the coin
quiz.ex: From the height he poured the oil, it went straight into the gourd through the hole in the coin.

quiz.q: When the oil seller lifted the coin after filling the gourd, what did the people see?
options: The coin did not have any trace of oil
The coin was fully covered in oil
quiz.ex: He showed people that the coin did not have any trace of oil.

quiz.q: What was the immediate reaction of the crowd after seeing the oil seller's skill?
quiz.ex: The crowd was shocked to silence. Then, one person cheered.

quiz.q: According to the oil seller, what was the secret behind his special skill?
options: It's only a matter of practice
quiz.ex: The oil seller smiled and said, 'As I told, there is nothing special about it. It’s only a matter of practice.'

quiz.q: How did Uthaman react at the end of the story?
options: He cried in front of the crowd
He was surprised and thanked him
quiz.ex: Uthaman was just as surprised as the crowd. He smiled and said, 'You have taught me something today. Thank you.'

quiz.q: What is the primary moral or theme of this story?
quiz.ex: The lesson's title and the core message is that consistent practice can help anyone master a skill.

quiz.q: Identify the speaker: 'Sir, there is no reason to be angry.'
quiz.ex: The oil seller says this calmly to Uthaman when he gets angry.

quiz.q: Identify the speaker: 'Hmm… Show us your skills.'
quiz.ex: Uthaman says this in a mocking tone to the oil seller.

quiz.q: Identify the speaker: 'You have taught me something today. Thank you.'
quiz.ex: Uthaman realizes his mistake and humbly thanks the oil seller for the lesson.

quiz.q: In the sports day passage, when was the annual sports day held?
quiz.ex: The passage states, 'We had our annual sports day on the 15th of this month.'

quiz.q: Who started the sports event according to the passage?
quiz.ex: The passage clearly mentions, 'The headmaster started the event.'

quiz.q: In the sports day passage, what place did the narrator get in the 100 meters race?
quiz.ex: The narrator says, 'In 100 meters race, I came first. I got a gold medal.'

quiz.q: Which of the following events did Martin take part in?
quiz.ex: The text states, 'Martin and I took part in 100 and 200 meters race.'

quiz.q: Who got the first prize in the 200 meters race?
quiz.ex: The narrator mentions, 'My friend Ravi got first in 200 meters.'

quiz.q: Which team won the relay race in the sports day event?
quiz.ex: It is stated that, 'The girl’s team won the relay race.'

quiz.q: Who won the first prize in the long jump?
quiz.ex: The text says, 'In the long jump, Rubesh won the first prize.'

quiz.q: In which grade is Rubesh studying?
quiz.ex: The passage mentions about Rubesh, 'He is in the sixth grade.'

quiz.q: Who was declared the 'champion of the year'?
quiz.ex: The text clearly states, 'Yasmin was the champion of the year.'

quiz.q: How did the sports day events close?
quiz.ex: The passage ends with, 'The events closed with a giving away the prizes.'

quiz.q: What is the synonym of the word 'fast' as given in the exercise?
quiz.ex: In the vocabulary section, 'fast' matches with the similar meaning word 'speed'.

quiz.q: What is the synonym of the word 'afraid'?
quiz.ex: The word with the same meaning for 'afraid' is 'fear'.

quiz.q: What is the synonym of the word 'train' (as an action)?
quiz.ex: In the context of skills and sports, to 'train' means to 'practise'.

quiz.q: What is the opposite of the word 'fix'?
quiz.ex: The antonym for 'fix' is 'break'.

quiz.q: What is the opposite of the word 'young'?
quiz.ex: The opposite word for 'young' is 'old'.

quiz.q: What is the opposite of the word 'near'?
quiz.ex: The opposite word for 'near' is 'far'.

quiz.q: Which of the following words rhymes with 'nature'?
quiz.ex: In the rhyming match exercise, 'nature' rhymes with 'creature'.

quiz.q: Which of the following words rhymes with 'bird'?
quiz.ex: In the rhyming match exercise, 'bird' rhymes with 'herd'.

quiz.q: Which of the following words rhymes with 'face'?
quiz.ex: In the rhyming match exercise, 'face' rhymes with 'race'.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank with the correct connecting word: I worked hard ______ I got promotion.
quiz.ex: The result is getting a promotion, hence 'so' is used to show the consequence of working hard.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank with the correct connecting word: I was late ______ there was a heavy traffic.
quiz.ex: Heavy traffic is the reason for being late, hence 'because' is used to show the cause.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank with the correct connecting word: I missed the bus ______ I took a taxi.
quiz.ex: Taking a taxi is the resulting action of missing the bus, hence 'so' is the correct connector.

quiz.q: In the application form, what does 'DD/MM/YYYY' stand for?
quiz.ex: It refers to the Date of Birth format asking for Date, Month, and Year.

quiz.q: Who must attest the photo in the individual sports meet application form?
quiz.ex: The form instructs: 'Paste your photo to be attested by the head master'.

quiz.q: What is the meaning of the word 'unfazed' as used in the passage?
options: Not worried or surprised by something unexpected
quiz.ex: The oil seller was 'unfazed' by the crowd, meaning he was calm and undisturbed by them.

quiz.q: Why did Uthaman become angry with the old man initially?
options: The old man spilled his oil
The old man broke his bow
The old man dismissed his archery skills as just a matter of practice
The old man asked for money
quiz.ex: Uthaman was proud of his archery, but the old man said it's just practice, which hurt his ego.

quiz.q: What does the action of pouring oil without touching the coin demonstrate?
options: High level of precision achieved through daily practice
quiz.ex: It shows that doing the same task every day (filling gourds) made him perfectly accurate without any special talent.

quiz.q: Analogy Question - Fast : Speed :: Train : ?
quiz.ex: Fast and Speed are synonyms. The synonym for Train (as a verb here) is Practise.

quiz.q: Analogy Question - Near : Far :: Young : ?
quiz.ex: Near and Far are opposites. The opposite of Young is Old.

quiz.q: Life-scenario: If you want to become very good at drawing, what does this story advise you to do?
quiz.ex: The moral 'Practice makes a man perfect' teaches that consistent practice is the key to mastering any skill like drawing.

quiz.q:
Assertion (A): The crowd burst into a loud cheer for the oil seller. 
Reason (R): The oil seller gave them free oil.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
quiz.ex: The crowd cheered because they were amazed by his precise skill of pouring oil, not because he gave free oil.

quiz.q:
Match the following based on the Sports Day passage: 
1. Narrator 
2. Ravi 
3. Girls team 

A. Relay race winner 
B. 200m first prize 
C. 100m gold medal
quiz.ex: Narrator won 100m (1-C), Ravi won 200m (2-B), and the girls won the relay (3-A).

quiz.q: True or False: Uthaman's final reaction shows that he was arrogant till the end.
quiz.ex: False. He smiled and thanked the oil seller, showing he had humbled down and accepted the lesson.

quiz.q: If you are feeling 'afraid' before a sports match, what is the synonymous emotion you are experiencing?
quiz.ex: According to the vocabulary section, 'afraid' has the same meaning as 'fear'.

quiz.q: Choose the correct connector: It was raining heavily, ______ the match was cancelled.
quiz.ex: 'So' is used to show the result. The match was cancelled as a result of the heavy rain.

quiz.q: Why didn't the oil spill on the coin?
options: The oil seller used a very small ladle
His hands were perfectly steady from years of practice
The crowd helped him hold the gourd
quiz.ex: Years of repetitive practice gave him perfect control to pour from a height straight through the small hole.

quiz.q: What is the meaning of 'mocking tone'?
options: Speaking in a way that makes fun of someone
quiz.ex: A mocking tone is used to tease, ridicule, or show contempt.

quiz.q: Which of these traits did the oil seller possess?
quiz.ex: He patiently placed the gourd, calmly demonstrated his skill, and humbly said it's just practice.

quiz.q: What did the copper coin look like?
options: It had a hole at the centre
It had a king's face stamped on it
quiz.ex: The text states: 'The small coin made of copper had a small hole at its centre.'

quiz.q: What does the word 'trace' mean in the sentence 'the coin did not have any trace of oil'?
options: A very small amount or mark left behind
quiz.ex: In this context, trace means a mark, stain, or very tiny amount of oil.

quiz.q: HOTS Question: If the oil seller tried archery without practice, what would most likely happen?
options: He would hit the bullseye on the first try
He would miss the target because he lacks practice in archery
quiz.ex: Since skill comes from practice (as he stated), he would not be good at archery without practicing it.

quiz.q: What is the first step the oil seller did before pouring the oil?
options: He patiently placed an empty gourd on the ground
quiz.ex: The text details his methodical approach starting with: 'He patiently placed an empty gourd on the ground.'
